wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2016–17 |team = Ohio State Buckeyes |image = Ohio State Buckeyes logo.svg |conference = Big Ten Conference |division = |short_conf = Big Ten |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 17–15 |conf_record = 7–11 |head_coach = [[Thad Matta]] |hc_year = 13th |asst_coach1 = [[Dave Dickerson]] |asst_coach2 = [[Chris Jent]] |asst_coach3 = [[Greg Paulus]] |stadium = [[Value City Arena]] |champion = |bowl = |bowl_result = }} {{2016–17 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio State University]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach is [[Thad Matta]], in his 13th season with the Buckeyes. The Buckeyes played their home games at [[Value City Arena]] in [[Columbus, Ohio]] and were members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 17–15, 7–11 in [[2016–17 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a tie for 10th place. As the No. 11 seed in the [[2017 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Rutgers]]. On June 5, 2017, the school announced that head coach Thad Matta would not return as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/bigten/2017/06/05/thad-matta-coach-one-more-year-at-ohio-state/102517068/|title=Thad Matta out as coach at Ohio State|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-06-05|language=en}} On June 9, the school hired [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler]] head coach [[Chris Holtmann]] as head coach.{{Cite news|url=http://www.fresnobee.com/sports/article155271189.html|title=Ohio State hires Butler basketball coach Chris Holtmann|work=fresnobee|access-date=2017-06-09|language=en}}{{Dead link|date=September 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Buckeyes]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] with a record of 21–14, 11–7 in [[2015–16 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2015–16 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round of the [[2016 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitational tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Akron]] in the first round to before losing to [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]]. == Departures == {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
